name: .224 Cal-73gr Absolute Hammer™

ballisticCoefficients.note: Hammer Bullets: "G7-BC= .173 calculated from shot drops" (calculated from shot drops).
Hammer Bullets: "G1-BC= .345 calculated from shot drops" (calculated from shot drops).

note: Recommended use: Small to big game hunting. The product page also says: "This pure copper Absolute Hammer™ was designed for 1-7.25″ twist or faster barrels. We kept the length of this bullet down a bit to help with dynamic stability in the very fast hot rod 22 caliber cartridges. Like all of the Absolute Hammer™s they should only be loaded by experienced hand loaders that are comfortable with developing a load for a cartridge that does not line up with conventional data. The engraving pressure for the Absolute Hammer™s is very low and they need more powder to get to pressure than conventional bullets."
